embeds.title: BLHA FRANCHISE HQ
embeds.description: Each franchise gets its own space to plan, organize and build an identity.

fields.name: USE THESE ROOMS FOR
fields.value: Team identity • Planning and strategy • Internal organization • Co-owner coordination

fields.name: ONE FRANCHISE, ONE VOICE
fields.value: Co-owners may share a franchise space, but each franchise has one formal league vote and one dues obligation.

fields.name: OFFICIAL BUSINESS
fields.value: Votes, trades and rulings still happen in the League Office, the Trade Center and Fantrax, not here.
